items.name: Pho Bo Tai (Rare Beef Noodle Soup)
items.description: 12-hour simmered beef marrow broth, flat rice noodles, thinly sliced raw Irish flank steak, herbs.
items.allergen_notes: Nuoc mam (Vietnamese fish sauce) used in broth reduction.

items.name: Goi Cuon (Fresh Summer Rolls, 2 pcs)
items.description: Rice paper rolls packed with poached shrimp, pork, fresh mint, vermicelli noodles, peanut hoisin dip.
items.allergen_notes: Dipping sauce contains crushed roasted peanuts and fermented soybean paste.

items.name: Bun Cha Gio (Crispy Spring Roll Bowl)
items.description: Warm vermicelli noodles, crispy fried pork spring rolls, shredded lettuce, cucumber, pickled carrots.
items.allergen_notes: Spring roll wrappers contain wheat flour; nuoc cham dip contains fish sauce.
